update.author: linux-security@amazon.com
update.title: Amazon Linux 2023 - ALAS2023-2023-061: Important priority package update for ca-certificates
update.description: Package updates are available for Amazon Linux 2023 that fix the following vulnerabilities: CVE-2022-23491: Certifi is a curated collection of Root Certificates for validating the trustworthiness of SSL certificates while verifying the identity of TLS hosts. Certifi 2022.12.07 removes root certificates from "TrustCor" from the root store. These are in the process of being removed from Mozilla's trust store. TrustCor's root certificates are being removed pursuant to an investigation prompted by media reporting that TrustCor's ownership also operated a business that produced spyware. Conclusions of Mozilla's investigation can be found in the linked google group discussion.

update.title: Amazon Linux 2023 - ALAS2023-2023-082: Important priority package update for python-bottle
update.description:
Package updates are available for Amazon Linux 2023 that fix the following vulnerabilities: CVE-2022-31799: Bottle before 0.12.20 mishandles errors during early request binding.
CVE-2022-3179: Weak Password Requirements in GitHub repository ikus060/rdiffweb prior to 2.4.2.
